Signature.purpose: Loads the selected document of a markdown docs corpus
Signature.description: Fetches the selected document through docUrl, via a page-session cache, so a document already read is shown again without a request. The site tree lives in BookIndexTreeService. Apps subclass it to add their own state; the books kit registers it as-is.

Prop.description: Document id to show; writing it loads that document — write-only
URL template for one document, '*' substituted
jsDelivr listing URL of the book's GitHub repo; repoUrl is derived from it
URL of a store page selling the book; optional, shown as a sidebar link when set

State.description: The book's GitHub repo URL, from indexUrl
Markdown source of the loaded document
True while the document is loading
